meta.name: The Grimm Variations
meta.description:
Inspired by the classic Brothers Grimm stories, this anthology features six fairy tales with a dark twist, exposing the shadowy side of human desire.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: Cinderella
videos.overview: Once upon a time, there was a young girl who loved playing with dolls. But Kiyoko's new stepfamily soon realizes that they may be her new playthings.

videos.title: Little Red Riding Hood
videos.overview: In a dystopian future, Grey and his club of "wolves" use AR to hunt and kill women for leisure — until he meets his first real-life prey, Scarlet.

videos.title: Hansel and Gretel
videos.overview: In the deepest, darkest part of the forest, Hansel and Gretel face a tough dilemma when an old woman tempts them with sweets and forbidden knowledge.

videos.title: The Elves and the Shoemaker
videos.overview: Years after his last success, washed-up writer N encounters a sharp-tongued child and later wakes up with a literary hit — one he can't remember writing.

videos.title: The Town Musicians of Bremen
videos.overview: Former deputy Dog roams the land with unlikely companions, but their search for a home is interrupted when they run into the notorious Wade Brothers.

videos.title: Pied Piper of Hamelin
videos.overview: The sheltered and precocious Maria is content with her bleak village life until her obsessed teacher shows her an illicit picture from the outside world.
